meta.title: Fix preloading of next track
meta.body_summary: Fix preloading of next track in audio player so the preload audio element fetches the upcoming song, with changelog update.

perf_labels.notes: Maintainer's own simple fix via Codex; merged quickly with no review; preload source now uses correct next track URL.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 10 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. As a small-scope fix, it is consistent with a fast, no-review merge.

review_details.performance_claim: Ensure preload audio element fetches the upcoming song to prevent playback delay.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A single-line fix in a JavaScript audio player is well within agent capability; the change required only updating the preload source to the next track URL, which is a straightforward service call.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer linked issue #605, which likely documented the preload failure; the fix was directly applied.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or before/after metrics; only composer validate test.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression handling needed; PR merged immediately with no adverse feedback.

core_change_summary.description: In js/player.js, changed the preload audio element's src to use the upcoming song's URL (this.currentIndex) instead of the current track, ensuring the next song is fetched in advance. Also updated CHANGELOG.md.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Changelog entry documents the preload fix.
change_trajectory: Single commit by Rello: set preload source to next track URL.

review_signals.summary: Linked issue #605 as context for the fix.

collaboration_trajectory: Maintainer Rello committed fix, labeled as codex, linked issue, and merged within ~16 minutes with no external review.
